desc: Huh... if we go by [**their entries in *SCoOW,***](https://en.touhouwiki.net/wiki/Strange_Creators_of_Outer_World/Who's_Who_of_Humans_%26_Youkai_in_Gensokyo/Shizuha_and_Minoriko_Aki) Shizuha seems to be the stylish one. You know, art sense and all. I can imagine now that Shizuha is the one who dresses Minoriko to at least a presentable state. That is to say, Minoriko by her default styling is probably plain and down to earth. Possibly muddy.
